```python
import re
import pandas as pd

# Assume 'lines' from previous step is available; reconstruct here for reproducibility
lines = [
(1, 'Seahorse Island Accommodations'), (1, 'Name  Rating (out of 5)  Vacancy  Pool  Sample Review'), (1, 'Hotels'), (1, "Neptune's Palace  5  Yes  Yes  'A perfect stay'"), (1, 'Admiral Sturgeon  5  No  Yes  Fantastic service'), (1, 'Currents  4  Yes  No  Great food'), (1, 'The Laughing Gull  3  Yes  No  Comfortable'), (1, 'Loach Towers  2  No  Yes  Cozy'), (1, 'Motels'), (1, 'Sea Escape Inn  5  Yes  No  Value stay'), (1, 'Wash Inn  3  Yes  No  Clean rooms'), (1, 'Boulevard Motel  2  Yes  No  Basic'), (1, 'Good Motel  1  Yes  No  Budget'), (1, 'Sea Larva Motel  0  Yes  No  Poor experience'), (2, 'Motels (continued)'), (2, 'Motel A  4  Yes  No  Nice'), (2, 'Motel B  4  No  No  Okay'), (2, 'Motel C  4  Yes  Yes  Good'), (2, 'Motel D  3  Yes  No  Decent'), (2, 'Motel E  3  No  No  Fine'), (2, 'Motel F  3  Yes  No  Satisfactory'), (2, 'Motel G  2  Yes  No  Adequate'), (2, 'Motel H  2  Yes  No  Average'), (2, 'Motel I  2  No  No  Fair'), (2, 'Motel J  1  Yes  No  Barebones'), (2, 'Motel K  1  No  No  Spartan'), (2, 'Motel L  1  Yes  No  Minimal'), (2, 'Motel M  0  Yes  No  Avoid'), (2, 'Motel N  0  No  No  Skip'), (2, 'End of listings')
]

accom = []
current_type = None
for page, ln in lines:
    t = ln.strip()
    if re.fullmatch(r"Hotels", t):
        current_type = "Hotels"
        continue
    if re.match(r"^Motels", t):
        current_type = "Motels"
        continue
    # parse entries: name then rating number
    m = re.match(r"^(.*?)\s+(\d+)\s+", t)
    if m and current_type:
        name = m.group(1).strip()
        rating = float(m.group(2))
        accom.append({"Name": name, "Type": current_type, "Rating": rating})

df = pd.DataFrame(accom)
print(df.head(10))
print(df['Type'].value_counts())
```
